bugs.description: INJECTED (declaration-renamed): Exported function renamed without updating its callers. `getAcceptHeader` renamed to `getAcceptHeaderV2` in its declaration only; callers still use `getAcceptHeader`. Mutated packages/server/src/unstable-core-do-not-import/http/contentType.ts:8: `export function getAcceptHeader(headers: Headers): TRPCAcceptHeader | null {` -> `export function getAcceptHeaderV2(headers: Headers): TRPCAcceptHeader | null {`. The bug manifests in packages/server/src/unstable-core-do-not-import/http/resolveResponse.ts:304: `const isStreamCall = getAcceptHeader(req.headers) === 'application/jsonl';`.
